purpose: Post-freeze descriptive held-out paired improvement by graph/stacking inputs; no model fits
sample: 721 supported final holdouts (500 Janus + 221 HetDB); 21 abstentions remain outside conditional error summaries
definition: improvement = absolute Anderson error - absolute frozen ML gap error; positive means lower ML error
weighting: Within each stratum, configurations averaged per physical pair, pairs equal within source, available sources equal in macro
thresholds: Unweighted fixed-fitting-record medians, established without holdout outcomes; missing values excluded and counted

bootstrap.CI: percentile 95%; both nonempty sources required in a macro replicate

canonical_flip_11_vs_00.note: error vectors are [Anderson MAE, ML MAE, positive improvement]

canonical_flip_01_vs_00.note: error vectors are [Anderson MAE, ML MAE, positive improvement]

canonical_flip_10_vs_00.note: error vectors are [Anderson MAE, ML MAE, positive improvement]

translation_21_vs_12.note: error vectors are [Anderson MAE, ML MAE, positive improvement]

graph_mean_edge_distance_difference_A.definition: absolute difference between arithmetic means of cached edge_distance_A arrays for lower and upper monolayer graphs
graph_mean_edge_distance_difference_A.graph_edges: All retained directed periodic intralayer neighbor edges under 5 Angstrom radius / complete-shell target-24 contract; not nearest-neighbor bond lengths

max_absolute_prescribed_principal_strain.definition: maximum absolute principal strain among both layers, in fractional units (100 times is percent)
max_absolute_prescribed_principal_strain.input_origin: Janus qian candidate geometry, predictive_input_eligible=true, model_stage_role=input_geometry; no hou/final DFT filling

Janus_correlation_graph_distance_differe.interpretation: Overlapping descriptors of mismatch; associations cannot be assigned independent causal contributions

true_twist_support.interpretation: No true-twist accuracy advantage can be estimated from this input definition
